# Stage-2 sample inventory (MG5_aMC 2.9.22 + Pythia 8.313), generated by `scripts/make_samples_md.py`

All σ are LO, CT18NLO, **N_IC = 1** (multiply by N_IC = 2), in fb, MG Gμ EW scheme, unless the column says otherwise. `σ_matched` = Σw at the nominal merging scale (MLM, qCut 45 GeV unless stated). **`σ_norm (N_IC=2)`** = recommended normalisation for yields: N_IC = 2 × K(theory_signal_model §2.3) × LO(α = 1/127.9) (see VALIDATION.md §1.2); it is stored in every npz (`sigma_norm_fb`, with `sigma_ref_fb`) and in `SAMPLES_INDEX.json` (`_sigma_norm_fb`). Yield of a selection at 3 ab⁻¹ = 3000 fb⁻¹ × `sigma_norm_fb` × Σw_sel / `sigma_ref_fb` (`mg_events.sigma_norm_fb`). The loader's `sigma_lo_mlm_fb` (alias `sigma_fb`) is LO-MLM without K, 17-38 % lower: not a yield normalisation. Files: `data/sim/npz/<ID>_m<m>.npz` (format: `scripts/convert_hepmc.py` header; loader `scripts/mg_events.py`); LHE (with 104 systematics weights) in `data/sim/lhe/<ID>/`; MG/Pythia logs, banners and DJR histograms in `data/sim/aux/<ID>/`. Seeds: MG `iseed` per chunk (Pythia job j of a chunk: (iseed × 10 + j) mod 9e8 + 1).

**Read before using the arrays directly.**
- **Rows with w = 0 exist** (14.9-25.0 % of the rows of matched files, V-NJ1 … V-TUNE-TRG): events vetoed by MLM at the nominal qCut but kept for the qCut 67.5/90 weight variations. Always weight with `w` or use the loader (which drops them).
- **Weights are not all equal**: in the stitched TRGS files the INC rows carry 3.7-9.6× the TRG per-event weight. Weight every summary with `w`, or use `iter_events(..., unweight=True)` (deterministic hit-or-miss).
- **Weight columns** (`wvar`, names in `wvar_names`; fb per event, N_IC = 1): the **merged** columns `..._MERGING=<qCut>` (107: 9 (μ_R, μ_F) × 5 dynamical scales, 58 CT18NLO members, NNPDF23LO, and the in-weight qCut 67.5/90 variations) are the physical ones; `Weight_MERGING=45.000` = `w`. The 104 `AUX_k` and `Weight` are the **unmerged LHE weights** (no MLM factor, non-zero on vetoed rows; their sums are 1.2-1.5 × σ_matched): AUX_k = LHE weight id k, with k = 1-44 the (μ_R, μ_F) ∈ {½,1,2}² × dynamical-scale {−1, 1 ΣpT, 2 H_T, 3 H_T/2, 4 √ŝ} variations (μ_R outermost; the central point is k = 45), k = 45 = central (CT18NLO member 0), k = 46-103 = CT18NLO members 1-58, k = 104 = NNPDF23_lo_as_0130_qed member 0; `Weight` = unmerged central. To use an unmerged column, multiply by the per-event merging factor w / AUX_45 (as `val_xsec.py` does for NNPDF23LO). Envelope recipes: 9-point (or 7-point without the (½,2) corners) on the merged MUF/MUR columns; CT18 Hessian asymmetric, 90 % CL → 68 % by ÷ 1.645.
- **Provenance and split** (all physics files): `chunk`, `ievt_lhe` (event in data/sim/lhe/<ID>/m<m>_c<chunk>.lhe.gz), `py8_job`, `ievt_job`, `py8_seed`; `scripts/reshower.py` regenerates the full particle record of any row (bit-for-bit, VALIDATION §6). `tt_split` = 0 (template) / 1 (toy): build templates and pseudo-data from different halves (`iter_events(..., split=...)`).
- **Statistics**: `N_eff` = (Σw)²/Σw² (Kish) of the selection; quote it, not the raw count.

**Not included in σ_norm** (all positive except NLO EW): inelastic γγ → QQ̄ +4.0-4.2 % of the K-corrected DY (T6, synthesis S-20; ESTIMATE); the infracolour Sommerfeld / threshold factor +5 to +15 % (TH §2.4/§5, no calculation exists; ESTIMATE); NLO EW −few % (UNVERIFIED). Nuisances on σ_norm: ±5 % K-transfer + EW-scheme (TH §2.4/§5), PDF4LHC21 ±3.7 / 6.6 / 18.5 % at 200 / 500 / 1000 GeV (TH §2.3), extrapolated K beyond 1200 GeV ±2 % (ESTIMATE). Not simulated: |q| = 2 (S-17), γγ → QQ̄, QED FSR off the quirks (Pythia setting inactive; −0.1…−1.1 % (stat. ±0.5…0.8 %) on the tail median of 2(γ*−1), mean −0.4…−0.8 ± 0.2 %; default: not applied, pending user decision: re-shower ≈ 15 CPU-h vs one-sided systematic; VALIDATION §7). K(13.6 TeV) of TH §2.3 is applied at 14 TeV (TH assumption, < 1.5 %).

Common settings: √s = 14 TeV; 5-flavour, massless b; `dynamical_scale_choice = -1`; Pythia8 CP5 (cards/pythia8_tune_CP5.dat) unless stated; MPI and hadronisation on; quirks stable (cards/pythia8_quirk_common.dat); vertex at origin; systematics `['--mur=0.5,1,2', '--muf=0.5,1,2', '--dyn=-1,1,2,3,4', '--pdf=CT18NLO,NNPDF23_lo_as_0130_qed@0']`; effective run cards in `cards/run_card_prod_*.dat`.

## Stitched trigger-region samples (recommended for pT(QQ̄) > 200 GeV studies; loader alias `trig`)

`<P>-TRGS_m<m>.npz` = `<P>-TRG` (ME cut pT(QQ̄)_ME ≥ 100 GeV) ∪ `<P>-INC` events with pT(QQ̄)_ME < 100 GeV (column `origin` = 0/1; weights unchanged). Built by `scripts/stitch_trg.py`; reason: VALIDATION.md §4.4 (4.0-7.1 % of the matched pT > 200 GeV cross section has a soft ME jet). **Rows are shuffled** with a recorded seed (`shuffle_seed`, `row_src`), so any prefix is a fair sample. **The INC rows carry 3.7-9.6× the per-event weight of the TRG rows** (column w/w_TRG below): use `w` (always returned by the loader as `info["w"]`) or `iter_events(..., unweight=True)`. TRGS and INC share the INC-complement rows, so they are not independent samples (the independent closure test is the generation-cut closure, VALIDATION §4.4). `sigma_ref_fb` = INC σ_matched; `nlhe` = N_LHE(TRG) + N_LHE(INC).

## V-SHOWER (Pythia ISR+FSR renormalisation-scale variation, 500 GeV; VALIDATION §5.1)

Re-shower (`scripts/run_vshower.sh`, `scripts/reshower.py`) of the kept LHE of E-TRG / E-INC m500 chunk 0 (50k LHE each), same seeds and card except `SpaceShower:renormMultFac = TimeShower:renormMultFac` = 0.25 (UP: μ_R × ½) or 4 (DN: μ_R × 2). Nominal reference = the chunk-0 rows of `E-TRG_m500.npz` / `E-INC_m500.npz`. Cards and logs: `data/sim/aux/fixer/V-SHOWER-*`.

| file | N_LHE | kept | σ_matched [fb] | md5 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `V-SHOWER-DN-INC_m500.npz` | 50000 | 30154 | 2.616 | cd60f580 |
| `V-SHOWER-DN-TRG_m500.npz` | 50000 | 27643 | 0.5358 | 06926038 |

Index for the loader: `data/sim/SAMPLES_INDEX.json` (keys `{spin}_{m}_{ID}` and aliases `{spin}_{m}_{incl,trig,lops}`; `_sigma_norm_fb` per point). V-INTERP (E-INC settings at the off-grid mass 550 GeV) is the mass-interpolation closure sample (VALIDATION §4.5). Top-ups 2026-10-11 (review S2-R1 B-4): E-TRG/E-INC 200 GeV +100k LHE each (chunks 2-3), E-TRG 300 +40k (chunk 1), E-INC 300 +50k (chunk 1).
Non-physics files are in `data/sim/npz/aux/`: pilot `P-INC_m500.npz` (2000 events, pipeline test) and `T2compat_cache.npz` (legacy-reader file written by `val_loader.py`, VALIDATION §6).
